messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: KV cache + continuous-batching amplification detected for service=runtime-prod. 5xx rate + cache churn spike observed. spike_start=2503456740. Paging #eng-oncall

maria_chen: ack — I’m on it. Pulling dashboards (kv evictions, batch sizes, tail latency).

samir: I see a correlated bump in live batching window usage and a sharp rise in kv_page faults from shard-3. Looks like microbatching config got applied more widely ~2503456700.

kiran_patel: who triggered the batch config rollout? any recent feature-flag changes?

lee: I deployed a small canary earlier for batch_adaptive_window=true but only 1% traffic — checking rollout logs. CLI shows canary_pct still 1%.

jess_c: customers with highest error rates: [acme-inc, globonet, shoply-prod]. acme-inc is 27% of error volume.

maria_chen: marking acme-inc as P0 customer for mitigation.

samir: proposed mitigation: 1) abort/rollback global rollout if exists, 2) apply per-tenant override to pin batch_window=64ms for affected tenants, 3) start a small canary hotfix that narrows batch window and disables prefetch for heavy tenants.

kiran_patel: starting per-tenant override for acme-inc now. Running command:```curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/batch_window/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-inc","window_ms":64}'
```

opsbot: executed override for tenant=acme-inc by kiran_patel at 2503456895. status=applied.

maria_chen: applying same override for globonet and shoply-prod.

lee: canary for hotpatch: reduce global default batch_window 256->96 for canary_pct=5. Command:```/rollout-flag batch_window --set 96 --canary 5 --note "mitigate cache amplification"```

samir: starting canary now. watching kv eviction rate and 5xx.

(2m later)

samir: canary metrics look good so far: 5xx down 40% in canary slice, kv eviction rate down 60% on canary nodes. No regression in latency for small seq lengths.

jess_c: acme-inc errors dropped ~75% after per-tenant override. total error volume trending down.

maria_chen: nice. keep canary at 5% for another 10m and then roll to 25% if stable.

kiran_patel: rolling to 25% now.```/rollout-flag batch_window --canary 25```

opsbot: rollout to 25% initiated at 2503457120.

(8m later)

samir: 25% slice stable. overall 5xx back to baseline, cache churn normalized. Monitoring for tail latencies.

maria_chen: moving to 100% but with per-tenant overrides still in place for acme-inc/globonet/shoply-prod. Doing staged ramp to avoid blast radius.```/rollout-flag batch_window --canary 50 && /rollout-flag batch_window --canary 100 --staged```

opsbot: staged rollout steps queued. next step in 2m.

(After full rollout)

jess_c: confirmed full rollout completed. overall 5xx ~ baseline, kv page faults down to normal. acme-inc error rate stable.

maria_chen: closing active mitigation. writing incident ticket/short RCA. root cause: overly aggressive adaptive batch_window expansion combined with prefix-caching interactions that caused amplified kv churn under certain seqlen distributions.

lee: follow-ups: 1) add automated guard that prevents >10% canary expansion if eviction_rate delta > X, 2) add per-tenant throttle for prefetch during sudden churn, 3) postmortem and add regression tests with synthetic seqlen bursts.

samir: I'll open the hotpatch PR that pins the adaptive logic and adds the guard. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.

maria_chen: Thanks all. final note for support: notify acme-inc/GloboNet/Shoply with summary + mitigation performed.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by team eng-oncall. Duration ~ 9m. Follow-up ticket: INF-4821 (add guardrails for batch/window rollouts).

maria_chen: moving to retrospective — please drop any logs/screenshots here for the postmortem. :memo:
